$comment: The author's Bluesky feed generators, one per language. Source of truth is the AT Protocol record set under the account's DID — regenerate with: curl 'https://public.api.bsky.app/xrpc/app.bsky.feed.getActorFeeds?actor=jmrp.io'. Checked-in rather than fetched at build so a Bluesky outage cannot break the build; names and descriptions are the records' own, verbatim, each in its feed's language. Snapshot: 2026-08-22.
